Field log [works] (art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05):
- 2026-10-01: "Fresh-store import_graph adopted the member identity, preserved all 65 nodes and 78 edges, and the fresh store's re-export compared identical to the original member."
- 2026-10-01: "The refused atomic import left an empty graph … fresh isolated import/re-export preserved identity and all 12 nodes/18 edges."
- 2026-10-01: "isolated import retained identity and exactly matched the export."
- 2026-10-02: "import_graph of a 110-node / 143-edge hand-built region document wrote everything with no skipped edges."
The hub's own check_repo.py now re-imports its committed exports as containment for the narrowed-edge case.

RE-MEASURED on main: a 2-node, 1-edge export was --imported into an empty store ("this store was empty, so it takes the imported design's name (a5fec0dfa50909f8)"). Its re-export had the same graph_id and an equal content_hash, and compare_designs read identical: true. A refused import writes nothing: the narrowed-edge import was refused all-or-nothing on all three binaries, and re-confirmed in fact:triage-2026-10-05-store-and-hub-items-fixed-in-0-78-0-or-not-reflow2s.
